top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §744.1103(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 6 active employees did not have a notarized affidavit.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Emergency Contact (26 TAC §744.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 3 children need emergency contact information for child admission form.

top_violation_types.title: AP Required Admission Information - Child able to swim competently (26 TAC §744.605(16)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The eight admission forms reviewed did not have information on whether or not each child was able to swim competently or had any conditions that would require them to be provided with a life jacket.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §744.1103(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 4 staff did not have completed affidavits.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §744.3501(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §744.3651)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The gas inspection available for review during the inspection expired on 05/13/2023.

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Thermometer, preferably non-glass (26 TAC §744.2753(a)(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The first aid kit was missing a thermometer.
